title: Measure just test at rest, for the user's ceiling decision
summary: Spec v2: a Chief of Staff study after batch-30 closes, no PR: five idle runs of just test in the main checkout at main's head (tracked files clean, load at most 10 % before each, 30 min wait), slowest tests, real-git share, suite without them; report in experiments/; then the ceiling choice (Q5).
